funding.name: Alabama Career Essentials (ACE)
funding.provides: Alabama Career Essentials is a free training course from the Alabama Community College System that leads to a Certified Employee certificate, a National Career Readiness Certificate and one free college course.
funding.amount: One free college course (up to 4 credit hours)

funding.name: ACCS Technical Training (short certificate programs)
funding.provides: Alabama community college technical training page states that for some programs no tuition is due, free childcare and job placement assistance are offered, and a $500 stipend is provided for required welding equipment.
funding.amount: $500 stipend for required welding equipment (welding program)

funding.name: ACCS Workforce Pathways Grant
funding.provides: Workforce Pathways Grant funds short-term, high-quality workforce training (credit or non-credit) that meets federal Workforce Pell eligibility and leads to employment.
funding.eligibility: Training must meet federal Workforce Pell eligibility requirements, per the grant guidelines page
funding.how_to_apply: Complete the Application for Workforce Pathways Grant, project budget, itemized equipment list, signature page and curriculum outline; grant applications for FY27 were announced to open 4/1/26

funding.name: AIDT workforce training for new and expanding companies
funding.provides: AIDT provides workforce development for Alabama new and expanding businesses and reports more than 47,000 Alabama citizens trained for a new career in 2025.

funding.name: Alabama state student grants and scholarships (ACHE)
funding.provides: The Alabama Commission on Higher Education administers several state-sponsored student grants and scholarships.

funding.name: Alabama Jobs Act tax credits (Jobs Credit and Investment Credit)
funding.provider: Alabama Department of Commerce (Made in Alabama)
funding.provides: The Alabama Jobs Act established the Jobs Credit and the Investment Credit to promote job creation and capital investment for qualifying projects.
funding.eligibility: Qualifying projects under sections 40-18-370 through 40-18-383 of the Code of Alabama 1975
funding.how_to_apply: Contact a Made in Alabama project manager
